title: Too many flaws.
text:
Too many flaws.. These AZ L1 Life Concept barstools are okay, but not the best out there. The assembly instructions were easy to follow, however the little knobs that screw in at the bottom on the legs would not screw in properly. I worked them in the best I could, however they are still a little wobbly when sitting on.

The other part I don’t care for is the extremely sharp edges on the seat area. If you have toddlers running around you may want to cross these off your list. I feel these should have been sanded for safety purposes.

Also, they are not comfortable to sit on... so I would look into getting a cushion for them.

For the price of these, there are much better options out there. I just found too many cons and not enough pros.
